scopes.timing: CPU percentages use acquisition-bracket midpoint durations; group entries are medians across run-level values. Latency p50/p95 are medians across per-run quantiles, not pooled sample quantiles.
scopes.gpu: Window-clipped complete X-event inclusive durations in Chrome GPU process. Nested event names overlap: do not add them. B/E and async durations excluded. Host event wall durations are not GPU-device execution time. Settling frames do not prove all GPU/compositor work drained before end mark.
scopes.trace: Perturbed attribution only; tracing, V8/GPU categories and wrapper instrumentation affect totals. Do not project trace shares onto independent timing CPU values.
scopes.api: Direct prototype-window counts normalized by actual GPUQueue.submit. Xterm direct counts unavailable; renderer trace b/B/X starts and instant n/i/I markers provide fallback command counts. Window-total averages are not per-frame distributions.
scopes.upload: Bytes are sums of wrapper bufferBytes deltas (WebGL bufferData argument byteLength/size); inclusive synchronous upload wall time is summed clipped upload spans. Empty xterm direct counters do not establish zero uploads. No native copy absence claim: prior positive control failed exact native copy/map visibility.

normalizationScope: One same-session three-way tracing artifact; median of per-repetition values. GPU host inclusive complete X durations overlap across nested names. All-thread temporal union and sum of per-thread task unions are distinct wall-time strata, neither is measured CPU or device execution. Per-terminal equivalents evenly divide the shared GPU-process window and are not actual isolated canvas costs.
seamScope: Event-name regex groups are candidate plumbing seams, not exclusive cost buckets. Individual event names/counts/durations and thread strata are authoritative; sums of regex groups would double-count nesting.

observability.directGpuGetCurrentTextureCalls: Direct API count available; this count does not time the GPU-process acquisition implementation.
observability.exactGpuGetCurrentTextureDuration: Unobservable: no exact GetCurrentTexture complete X event.
observability.perCanvasGpuCost: Unobservable: GPU event command-buffer/context identities are not linked to terminal/canvas identities. Dividing by actual terminal renders yields a window average, not an independently measured per-canvas cost.
observability.internalCopies: Unobservable: the prior verified copy/map positive control did not expose exact native operation names; absent names do not establish absent internal copies.
